item.title: Journal page fixed!
item.description: My fediverse instance changed softwares a few months back, and as a result the "Journal" page on my site that mirrored its feed was broken. I finally got around to fixing it so it gets the new feed now. Yay!

item.title: Overhauling My Journal
item.description:
When I started this website, I added a self-hosted little microblog to the page as a way to still have a "feed" to post to without having to rely on a mainstream, centralized social media platform. It was a fun experiment, but soon after I started it, I joined the Fediverse and eventually started self-hosting my own social account. At that point, the "journal" section of this site kind of became redundant and abandoned.

For a long time, I've been wanting to replace it with something else and well, I finally got around to it! I'm now mirroring some of my latest fediverse posts onto the new "Posts" page, repurposed from the previous "Journal" page. And for those who are going to miss my backlog of twtxt bangers, the old journal page is still up and linked to from the new one!

item.title: Residents Iceberg Article
item.description: I've added a new article to my Residents Shrine all about exploring a funny "iceberg chart" meme I made years ago. It took a long time to write up, so I recommend you check it out if you're into that sort of thing.

item.title: Kid Pilot Write-Up
item.description:
Here's an article I've been wanting to write up and post to this site since I've started it: Uncovering Kid Pilot's 20 Year Old Easter Egg

This is probably one of my favorite things I've written up for my site so far, so I hope you take a look! And look forward to more new things coming soon!

item.title: HTML Day 2025: New Lucid Dreaming Page!
item.description: Happy HTML Day! I've been pretty busy lately, but I've decided to add a small page to my site at the very least to celebrate the occasion. Check out the new Lucid Dreaming page I made. :)

item.title: Shrine Construction, Part 2: Welcome to RESIDENTS WORLD!!
item.description:
The shrines section of my site has been pretty much dead since I started working on the Pretty Rhythm shrine over a year ago. Well, I haven't really made any progress on the Pretty Rhythm shrine, but instead I've opened up a new shrine: RESIDENTS WORLD!

This shrine is dedicated to my favorite band of all time, The Residents. And unlike the Pretty Rhythm shrine, it's actually already open and in an explorable state. That being said, I have plenty of more updates planned for Residents World, so check back often!
